verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents its own initiative-level tracking: goals and objectives linked to projects, cross-team project mapping, health status and target dates, plus Epics on a Roadmap. Status is covered through health status, but no evidence shows a priority field, and an owning team is only implied by 'align teams' and 'across teams'. missing for 10: explicit priority attribute on initiatives/epics, explicit owning-team assignment, in-depth first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: Create goals, align teams, and connect individual projects to company objectives.
Map out projects across teams, track work from people and agents in one place, communicate health status, and share target dates.
